integrity: The all-field statement is proved symbolically from the bracket equation. Finite computation is used only as a consistency check. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: One-variable Jacobson–Witt algebra only; characteristic greater than three. No claim is made for higher-dimensional Jacobson–Witt algebras or for higher commuting tuples. The closest same-object commuting-variety paper was available only at abstract/metadata level in the accessible route, so possible overlap of intermediate geometric centralizer lemmas remains a stated risk.
title: Exact centralizer spectrum and commutativity degree of the finite Jacobson–Witt algebra \(W_1\)
